description: Java class AndroidLayoutPreviewPanel extending RenderedPanel, managing UI rendering, caret updates, and overlay interactions in Android layout preview within an IDE.

classes.name: AndroidLayoutPreviewPanel
classes.description: A panel for rendering and interacting with Android layout previews, handling caret updates, overlays, and view selection.

methods.name: installHover
methods.description: Sets up mouse listeners for hover overlays on the preview panel.

methods.name: getPanelHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the panel based on parent size.

methods.name: getPanelWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the panel based on parent size.

methods.name: paintRenderedImage
methods.description: Paints the rendered image and overlays.

methods.name: selectView
methods.description: Selects a view in the editor based on the rendered view.

methods.name: updateCaret
methods.description: Updates the editor caret position based on the current selection.

methods.name: setRenderResult
methods.description: Sets the rendering result and updates the editor and caret.

methods.name: setEditor
methods.description: Associates a TextEditor with the panel and manages caret listeners.

methods.name: setOverlayContainer
methods.description: Sets the overlay container for UI overlays.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given XML tag is currently selected.
